description: 白后透视黑后对角线，象清路得子
explanation_en: White's queen already attacks through Black's queen along the diagonal. Be5+ forces the black queen to move, after which White captures it with check and wins another piece.

intro.popup: 💡 透视攻击：白后在c3，透视穿越黑后d4，沿对角线直指h8。白方如何利用这条透视线？
intro.popup_en: 💡 X-ray attack: White's queen on c3 sees through Black's queen on d4 along the diagonal toward h8. How can White exploit this line?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Be5+强制黑后离开d4，白后透视线畅通，Qxe5+将军赢后，再Qxb2得子！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Be5+ forces Black's queen off d4. White's queen can then capture it with Qxe5+, followed by Qxb2 to win another piece.

moves.popup: 白象跳e5将军黑王h8！象沿对角线将军，强制黑后必须应将，透视线即将打通。
moves.popup_en: White's bishop checks the king on h8 from e5, forcing Black's queen to respond and preparing to open the X-ray line.

moves.popup: 黑后被迫从d4吃象应将，离开了白后的透视线。
moves.popup_en: Black's queen is forced to capture the bishop on e5, leaving White's queen's X-ray line.

moves.popup: 透视攻击！白后c3早已透视黑后d4盯住e5和h8。黑后离开后，白后直取e5将军！
moves.popup_en: X-ray attack! White's queen on c3 was aiming through the black queen on d4. Once it moves, White captures on e5 with check.
The black king moves to g8.

moves.popup: 白后吃黑马b2！透视攻击连续得子，白方赢得决定性物质优势。
moves.popup_en: White's queen captures the knight on b2. The X-ray combination wins further material and gives White a decisive advantage.
